overview_description.description: Million is the next generation of social media platforms. It helps creators break free and take control of their narrative. Creators monetize their content and audience from day one with pay per view, rent, subscriptions and e-commerce. They own their data and social graph.  Creators co-finance with their community disintermediating the gatekeepers. MILLION was founded in 2023 and is based in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates.
